composition_subtypes.role: Sort sizes to enable linear greedy scan
Greedy count of unswallowed groups using next-distinct check

payload.core_composition_summary: Sort sizes, then linear greedy scan to count groups that cannot be swallowed by any larger element within K
payload.rationale: Sorting enables efficient greedy pass: for each group of equal sizes, if next distinct size > current + K, all in group survive; else they may be swallowed.
